title: Apple & Peanut Oat Bowl
description: Warm oats with crisp apple and a spoon of peanut butter.
steps: Slice the apple; set a few pieces aside for topping.
Simmer the oats with milk, stirring until tender according to the oat package.
Spoon into two bowls and add the apple and peanut butter.

title: Berry Yogurt Oats
description: A cool, mix-and-eat bowl with fruit and rolled oats.
steps: Stir the oats into the yogurt and divide between two bowls.
Slice the banana and add it with the berries.
Eat promptly or keep chilled according to the ingredient labels.

title: Lemony Chickpea Rice
description: Rice, greens and chickpeas brightened with lemon.
steps: Cook the dry rice according to its package.
Warm the drained chickpeas and spinach in olive oil until the greens wilt.
Fold through the rice and finish with lemon juice.

title: Carrot & Red Lentil Skillet
description: A soft, savory lentil pan with carrot and garlic.
steps: Dice the carrot and onion; mince the garlic.
Soften the vegetables in olive oil, then add rinsed red lentils and water as directed on the lentil package.
Simmer until the lentils are tender, stirring and adding water as needed.

title: Crunchy White Bean Wraps
description: Cool cucumber and tomato tucked into bean-filled tortillas.
steps: Wash and dice the cucumber and tomato.
Mash the drained beans with the yogurt and spread over the tortillas.
Add the vegetables and fold into wraps; follow package handling guidance.

title: Spinach & Tomato Pasta
description: A quick pasta with softened tomato and wilted greens.
steps: Cook the dry pasta according to its package; reserve a little cooking water.
Gently cook chopped tomato and garlic in olive oil, then wilt the spinach.
Toss with pasta and a splash of cooking water.

title: Pepper & Black Bean Rice
description: A simple rice bowl with tender peppers and beans.
steps: Cook the dry rice according to its package.
Soften sliced pepper and onion in olive oil, then warm the drained beans.
Serve the vegetables and beans over the rice.

title: Creamy Pea & Lemon Pasta
description: Peas and yogurt make a bright, gently creamy pasta.
steps: Cook the pasta and peas according to their packages; drain, saving a little pasta water.
Off the heat, coat with yogurt, olive oil and lemon juice.
Loosen with reserved cooking water and serve.

title: Tofu & Cucumber Quinoa Bowl
description: Warm quinoa and tofu with a cool cucumber finish.
steps: Cook the dry quinoa according to its package.
Cook cubed tofu in olive oil following its package directions.
Wash and cut the cucumber and carrot; serve with quinoa and tofu and squeeze lemon over top.

title: Warm White Beans & Greens
description: Tomato-warmed beans and kale with toasted bread.
steps: Soften chopped tomato and garlic in olive oil.
Add drained white beans and chopped kale; cook until the greens wilt and everything is heated through.
Toast the bread and serve alongside the beans.
